name: Stencil Issue Templates for Jira
tagline: Issue templates that fire wherever work items are actually created — backlog, board, epic, mobile, JSM portal — with whole epic-to-sub-task trees, placeholders and prompted variables. Free for 10 users, then US$0.79 per user
highlights: It fires where you actually create work items

Live on the global create dialog, and a few seconds after the fact on every other surface: backlog inline create, board quick-add, create-child-from-an-epic, mobile, the JSM portal, CSV import, REST and Automation.
Whole trees, and you see them before anything is created
Epic to story to sub-task, up to 300 work items and four levels. Applying twice creates nothing extra, and a run interrupted halfway resumes instead of leaving orphans.
Everything the category leader charges two editions for, on one plan
Default template per issue type and per JSM request type, JQL conditions, usage reports and an audit log — all included, at US$0.79 per user per month.
